findings.title: An Arabic hint on the wrong side of the field
findings.message: The placeholder "رمز الخصم (اختياري)" is Arabic in a left-to-right field.
findings.fix: Keep dir="ltr" for what people type, and right-align the Arabic hint with input:placeholder-shown { direction: rtl } or ::placeholder { text-align: right }.
findings.snippet: <input type="text" dir="ltr" inputmode="text" autocomplete="off" placeholder="رمز الخصم (اختياري)" aria-label="رمز الخصم">

findings.title: Two digit systems on one screen
findings.message: "تفاحة روسية – 1 كجم" uses a different digit system from the rest of the screen.
findings.fix: Pick one digit system for the product and format every number with it.

findings.title: Arabic text cut off by its box
findings.message: Only 35% of this text shows before the ellipsis.
findings.fix: Let the box grow with min-width or min-height. If shortening is intended, add text-overflow: ellipsis and leave room for most of the text.

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic" is named but never loaded.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".
